title: 55세 이후 연금저축·IRP 통합과 분리 — 계약이전·세금·인출 전략

source_audit.limitations: No issuer contract transfer confirmation or individual IRP actual pension commencement/withdrawals and 2025 legacy tax certificate authenticated; original audio and video not certified.
source_audit.evidence_reference: All 877 original Korean SRT cues processed; 23 timecoded retirement-account consolidation, pension transfer and tax-source claims independently triaged.

core_message: 세제적격 연금보험과 비적격 일반보험을 구별하고, IRP 미공제원금·이연퇴직금·공제원금/수익 재원별 세금 및 55세 연금개시 요건을 적용
